title: Mumbo Copper Golems
description: I was recently watching a Mumbo video when i saw a comment from @Charro0_0.  This pack changes the new copper golem textures to look similar to the iconic Mumbo mustache
body:
This pack changes the newly added copper golem to look like Mumbo/Grumbot. Inspired by commenter: @Charro0_0 on [this video.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cn4cCdQMn0c)
